name: 27040 · Pfafftown, NC
findings: ZIP 27040 (Pfafftown) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27040 (Pfafftown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27040 (Pfafftown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
